system.longDesc:
These rounds are soft “gels” filled with liquid, designed to burst on impact, like paintball rounds, which just stain a target with a colored pigment. A gel round inflicts only 1 point of stun damage, easily overcome by armor and Toughness, but it is usually what the round carries that is a concern. In addition to paint, gel rounds might be loaded with skin irritants (requiring a Constitute (Tolerance) test to avoid a penalty to all tests due to distraction, typically TN 13 and a –2 penalty). They might also use a solution of dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) as a carrier for certain drugs; the DMSO makes the drug absorbed through the skin, if hit by the gel rounds. See Drugs for possible gel loads (not included in the cost of the gel rounds).

Resources TN 6.
